pairs.note: Motion-blurred kick: Tomoe's kicking leg extends into Sakuta's side, her arm swings out behind her, body leans into the kick.

Reframed wider: Sakuta is flung toward screen-left with arms out and one leg kicked back; Tomoe pulls her leg back with knee raised, raises a fist, shouts (mouth open, angry face). The lost child is now visible between them.
Sakuta flies further left, reaching hand opens toward camera, head turns toward camera; Tomoe extends the kicking leg straight out, mouth shape changes.
Sakuta falls further to screen-left, head turned more toward the viewer, clenched teeth open into a shout, hand reaches further; Tomoe leans back, her fist arm swings out to the side, leg stays high.
